# Proof of Proposition <a href="consumption-and-interest-rates/consumption-and-interest-rates-with-a-borrowing.md#prop:dcdr_decomp" data-reference-type="ref" data-reference="prop:dcdr_decomp">2</a>

Given the consumption function from Theorem
<a href="an-explicit-consumption-function-and-its/the-optimal-consumption-function.md#thm:cons_func" data-reference-type="ref"
data-reference="thm:cons_func">1</a> and taking the partial derivative
with respect to $`r`$, one gets:
``` math
\begin{align*}
\frac{\partial c^\ast(a,y;r,\underline{a})}{\partial r} = a - \frac{\rho}{\gamma r^2}(1+w(a)) +\frac{\rho-r}{\gamma r}\frac{\partial w(a)}{\partial r}
\end{align*}
```
